lines.text: - The lamp burned paraffin until the 1958 refit. #status/provisional
- The tower has one hundred and twelve steps. #status/provisional
- The lens came from a works in Birmingham. #status/provisional
- The keeper winds the clockwork every four hours. #status/provisional
- Salt eats the brass fittings faster than anyone can polish them. #status/provisional
- The oil store sits apart from the tower in case of fire. #status/provisional
- Supply boats come on the first Monday of the month. #status/provisional
- In winter the supply boat can be three weeks late. #status/provisional
- The radio set is newer than anything else on the rock. #status/provisional
- The cottage has two rooms and a scullery. #status/provisional
- Rainwater is caught off the cottage roof into a cistern. #status/provisional
- The gallery rail is loose on the seaward side. #status/provisional
- Gulls nest on the oil store roof every spring. #status/provisional
- A bell hangs by the landing for fog when the signal fails. #status/provisional
- The logbook records the weather every three hours. #status/provisional
